title: Normalized Project State
description: Validation contract for normalized project-state instances. State instances are YAML files (automation/state/<project_id>.yaml). JSON Schema is used only as the validation contract because YAML is compatible with the JSON data model. Do not switch normalized project-state files from YAML to JSON.

project_id.description: Stable identifier matching the Project Registry project_id.

source_path.description: Absolute local path of the source repository (as recorded in the Project Registry).

repository.description: Remote URL or null if no remote.

branch.description: Active branch or null if unknown.

head.description: HEAD commit SHA or null if unknown.

project_state.description: Verified state string or 'unknown'. Must not be guessed.

current_goal.description: Current goal or null if none/unknown.

current_work.description: Current work description or null if none/unknown.

current_work_authority.description: Where the current-work claim came from. Separate from evidence confidence.

path.description: Source file/path the current-work claim was read from, or null.

kind.description: Type of authority document the claim was read from, or null.

current_work_evidence.description: How strongly the current-work claim is supported. Separate from current_work_authority.

ci_state.description: CI state or null/unknown if not verified in this WO.

open_pr.description: Open PR number (integer) or null if none/not verified.

last_change.description: ISO-8601 date of last commit, or null if unknown.

next_action.description: Next action or null if unknown.

evidence_classification.description: Overall evidence confidence for the normalized state record as a whole.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this state was verified, or null.

adapter_id.description: Identifier of the adapter that produced this state.
